entities.name: Mannichi
entities.description: A kami of Kamigawa, the mischievous little spirit of fevers and hallucinations.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war on Kamigawa to which Mannichi's fevered dream contributed.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: A man who saw the eyes of Kyodai in a fevered dream.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Whose eyes Takeshi Konda saw in a fevered dream.

events.summary: During a fevered dream, Takeshi Konda saw the eyes of Kyodai and understood how to make his empire last forever.
events.quote: it was during a fevered dream that Takeshi Konda saw the eyes of Kyodai and understood at that moment how to make his empire last forever

relations.note: Mannichi could be said to be partly at fault for the Kami War.
relations.quote: Mannichi could be said to be partly at fault for the Kami War
